title: fix(desktop): move Start recording into the record widget (NIW2-562)
body:
Fixes [NIW2-562](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-562).

## What changed

In the record overlay (Frame mode), the pink **Start recording** CTA was a pill centred under the box. When the box fills the screen there is no room below, so the pill moved inside the box's bottom edge, right where the key hint pill sits, and the hint text drew over it.

Start recording is now the **last button of the vertical record widget** (modes, Mic / System audio / Camera, Cancel, **Start**): a 38 px solid pink button with the record dot and a small ↵, tooltip "Start recording · ↵". The widget already picks a free spot (right of the box, left, or inside it, top-aligned), so Start can no longer land on the hint.

- `record-chrome.tsx`: `RecordWidget` takes an optional `start` (`onStart`, `disabled`); `StartPill`, `startPillPlacement` and the pill constants are removed; `WIDGET_HEIGHT_DIP` grows 390 → 436 for the extra button.
- `frame-box.tsx`: passes `start` to the widget instead of rendering the pill.
- `capture-overlay.module.css`: `.startPill` styles replaced by `.widgetStart`.
- i18n: new `overlay.startRecordingTitle` (en, es).
- Spec `2026-10-26-record-capture-modes-design.md` updated, with the reason for the move.

Unchanged: Enter still starts, R still records, the button stays disabled for an area under the minimum size. The Screen card's "Record this display" and the Window picker are not touched.

## Verification

- `vitest run` in `apps/kaipu-record`: 2955 passed. The widget-order test now ends with "Start recording", and the record-chrome test asserts Start is inside the widget.
- `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json`: clean. oxlint + oxfmt: clean.
- Not checked in the running app (no screenshot yet).

## How to test it yourself

1. `bun run dev` in this checkout.
2. Click **Start recording** (Record page or tray) so the selector opens in **Frame** mode.
3. Drag the box out to fill the whole screen.
4. **Expected:** the key hint at the bottom is readable and nothing sits on it. The pink record button is at the bottom of the vertical widget (inside the box's right edge at full screen), under Cancel.
5. Hover it: tooltip "Start recording · ↵". Click it: the recording starts. Press Enter instead: it starts too.
6. Shrink the box below the minimum size: the pink button greys out and cannot be clicked.
7. Contrast, on `main`: same steps 1–3, and the "● Start recording ↵" pill sits under the hint text at the bottom centre.
